name: Crater Lake
description: Volcanic crater lake in south-central Oregon, main feature of Crater Lake National Park, known for its deep blue color and water clarity. Formed by the collapse of Mount Mazama approximately 7,700 years ago.
title: Crater Lake
intro: Crater Lake (Klamath: Giiwas) is a volcanic crater lake in south-central Oregon in the Western United States. It is the main feature of Crater Lake National Park and is a tourist attraction known for its deep blue color and water clarity. The lake partly fills a 2,148-foot-deep (655 m) caldera that was formed around 7,700 (± 150) years ago by the collapse of the volcano Mount Mazama.
